description: Evaluates Python dependency direction, ports and adapters, framework isolation, composition boundaries, and incremental migration without imposing a universal layer model.
user_intent_examples: Review whether this Python system needs ports, adapters, or a clearer composition boundary.
when_to_load: When dependency direction, framework isolation, ports/adapters, or a composition boundary is materially involved.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for local readability, simple scripts, KANDA box ownership, or generic architecture discussion without Python dependency evidence.
